purpose: manage a product from launch to retirement with decisions made on evidence and communicated to those affected
entry_criteria: The product is released or planned for release
Usage, revenue or cost data exists
A sponsor accepts decisions on investment and retirement
procedure: Define the lifecycle stages in use (introduce, grow, mature, decline, retire) and the signals for each.
Review each product on a regular schedule using the same measures: users, revenue, cost, risk and strategic fit.
Decide per product to invest, maintain, simplify or retire, and record the reason with the sponsor.
For retirement, plan the notice period, migration path, data handling and support end date.
Communicate to customers and internal teams in advance and track who has moved.
Shut down in stages, confirm nothing depends on it, and archive records required by policy.
acceptance_criteria: Every product has a stage and a decision
Retirement has notice, migration and data handling
The sponsor approved investment and retirement

validation.check: check each product in scope has a recorded stage and decision with date
confirm for each retirement that no active customers or internal consumers remain

failure_modes.detection: No review in over a year

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A reporting add-on has 3 percent of users and 15 percent of support load. The sponsor approves retirement with six months notice and a migration guide; usage is tracked until it reaches zero.
